{"command": "cat > generate_figure.py <<'PY'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


t = np.linspace(0, 10, 201)
f1 = np.exp(-0.5 * t)
f2 = np.exp(-t)
f3 = 0.5 * np.exp(-2 * t) + 1e-4

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(t, f1, color='#1b9e77', linestyle='-', marker='o', markevery=20,
        linewidth=2, label='exp(-0.5t)')
ax.plot(t, f2, color='#d95f02', linestyle='--', marker='s', markevery=20,
        linewidth=2, label='exp(-t)')
ax.plot(t, f3, color='#7570b3', linestyle='-.', marker='^', markevery=20,
        linewidth=2, label='0.5exp(-2t)+1e-4')

ax.set_yscale('log', base=10)
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(1e-5, 2)
ax.set_xlabel('t (s)')
ax.set_ylabel('amplitude')
ax.set_title('Three decays on a log scale')
ax.grid(True, which='major', axis='both', linestyle=':')
ax.legend(loc='lower left')

fig.savefig('figure.png', dpi=150)
plt.close(fig)
PY
python generate_figure.py

python - <<'PY'

im = Image.open('figure.png')
print('size:', im.size, 'format:', im.format, 'dpi:', im.info.get('dpi'))
PY"}
